subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose `ctx.api.resetSession(reason?)` as a plugin-facing API limited to successful after-compaction hooks?
rationale: The patch is technically plausible, but adding a session-mutating plugin contract and defining its availability and completion semantics requires maintainer intent rather than automated review judgment.

options.title: Approve the narrow hook API
options.body: Keep the current-session-scoped deferred design, document its hook availability and accepted-versus-completed semantics, and require current-head lifecycle proof before merge.

options.title: Keep reset policy internal
options.body: Replace the plugin API with an internal or generic compaction-recovery policy seam so plugins do not directly request session rotation.

options.title: Pause the capability
options.body: Close or defer this PR until a broader plugin session-lifecycle API is designed and approved.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow hook API
recommendation.body: Keep the current-session-scoped deferred design, document its hook availability and accepted-versus-completed semantics, and require current-head lifecycle proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history most strongly connects this person to plugin public surfaces and the Codex runtime path touched by the proposed contract.
